content.short: SoCool is a creator-economy wallet and DAO infrastructure with cross-chain token management, NFT collection, token minting, and DAO voting.
content.description: SoCool combines decentralized autonomous organization infrastructure with a cross-chain wallet designed for the creator economy. Users can securely store, buy, send, receive, and swap tokens across multiple blockchains, and collect NFTs across networks. The platform also supports minting tokens and participating in DAO voting. Developers can access SoCool’s financial tools and engage with the communities built around these capabilities.
content.meta: SoCool is a DAO infrastructure and wallet for a creator economy. Discover SoCool and other Web3 Social Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
